title: The John C. Rice-May Irwin Kiss
description: In a medium closeup shot of the first kiss ever recorded on screen, two fervent lovers cuddle and talk passionately at a hair's breadth, just before the love-smitten gentleman decides to give his chosen one an innocent peck.

title: A Mortal's Journey
description: The story of Han Li, a poor and ordinary boy from a village. In order to let his family lead a better life, he willingly heads to Qi Xuan Sect to take their entrance exam. He was accepted by Mo Da Fu, and begins his journey in jianghu.

title: Spring of the Blade
description: After losing her mother as a child, Xie Qingyuan returns years later to uncover the truth and seek justice. Reuniting with Shen Run, once a fallen youth and now a righteous court official, they join forces to expose corruption and right past wrongs. Through shared dangers and unwavering support, they grow closer, devoting their lives to protecting each other and their people.

title: This Is How We Were Before, How Are You Doing Now?
description: Set at the turn of the 20th century during the Filipino revolution against the Spaniards and, later, the American colonizers, it follows a naive peasant through his leap of faith to become a member of an imagined community.

title: O hrysos tis Argolidas - Agapi kai ponos gia to portokali
The Seven Relics of ill Omen
description: Seven evil thoughts capable of corrupting human nature were sealed into bamboo strips by Lao Zi using the Phoenix Lock. Unexpectedly, these cursed strips resurface, threatening to unleash chaos.

title: Outside In: Getting Lost and Found in Alaska
description: A photographer/cinematographer in an emotional rut travels from Austin to Alaska to get lost in the beauty of nature, and in the process, finds himself again.

title: Got Dumped. Got LadyAid.(English-dubbed)
description: A broke delivery guy, Gavin, is dumped by his girlfriend the day she graduates for a rich man. Humiliated, he activates the LadyAid Cash-back System: help a woman, get huge cash. A small favor earns $78K. Soon, he's saving women from debt and disaster, rising from zero to mansions, a restaurant empire, and a law firm. His ex fights back with lies and schemes, but every woman he helped has his back. She ends up in jail. Gavin walks away with Paige's heart, a fortune, and no regrets.
